title: Web Summit to take place in Rio de Janeiro in its first move outside Europe (The Irish Times)
what_it_says: The Irish Times reports that Web Summit planned an event in Rio de Janeiro, its first outside Europe, committed to the city for at least three years, with the city's mayor saying Rio would put in no direct money and Senac as main sponsor. It quotes the chief executive on Brazil's tech ecosystem and on the Rio event being very different in scale from Lisbon at first.
status: publication date not shown on the page as fetched; its 'May next year' places the planned first event in the following year, so it is not placed on the timeline
